articles.title: 'Toxic' box office collection day 12: Yash, Tara Sutaria, Kiara Advani, Nayanthara film earns Rs 2.35 cr on Sunday, taking India net collection to Rs 245.75 cr
articles.summary: Yash's 'Toxic: A fairy tale for grownups' continued its box-office journey on its second Sunday. The movie recorded an India net collection of Rs 2.35.
articles.body: Yash's 'Toxic: A fairy tale for grownups' continued its box-office journey on its second Sunday. The movie recorded an India net collection of Rs 2.35 cr on day 12, according to Sacnilk. The latest figure came from 1,677 shows across India. With the day's earnings added, the film's India net collection has reached Rs 245.75 cr. Its domestic gross currently stands at Rs 293.30 cr. The movie has also maintained its presence in overseas markets. Its overseas gross collection has reached Rs 44.50 cr. This takes the worldwide gross of 'Toxic' to Rs 337.80 cr after 12 days.'Toxic' records a rise in numbers on day 12'Toxic' collected Rs 2.35 Cr on its second Sunday. The figure was slightly higher than the Rs 2.28 cr reported for the previous day. The movie had earned Rs 1.75 cr on its second Friday. The second Thursday brought in Rs 4.25 cr. The film's first-week collection stood at Rs 239.30 cr.'Toxic' box office day 12 collection across languagesThe Kannada version continued to account for the largest share of the film's India net collection on day 12. It earned Rs 1.45 cr from 632 shows. The Hindi version contributed Rs 85 lakhs from 957 shows. The movie also recorded earnings from its Tamil and Telugu versions. The two Tamil entries contributed Rs 2 lakhs from 28 shows and Rs 1 lakh from 24 shows. The Telugu versions added Rs 5 lakhs from 70 shows and Rs 4 lakhs from 64 shows.'Toxic' registers strong afternoon occupancy in KannadaThe Kannada version recorded 37.18% overall occupancy on Day 12. Morning shows registered 29.00% occupancy. The afternoon shows witnessed the strongest response for the Kannada version. They recorded 55.82% occupancy. Evening screenings registered 31.00%, while night shows stood at 24.64%.The Hindi version recorded 34.65% overall occupancy. Morning shows had 14.38% occupancy, while afternoon screenings reached 42.85%. Hindi evening shows recorded 30.54% occupancy. Night screenings registered 36.08%.Amid the box office success, the film is receiving mixed reviews. ETimes review noted similarities with 'KGF' in the way the protagonist and his violent surroundings are presented. At the same time, it described the world of 'Toxic' as incomplete and confusing in certain sections.Director Geethu Mohandas has kept Yash at the centre of the movie's commercial appeal. The review also observed that the film's pace increases as the story progresses.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. articles.title: Kailash Kher on Samay Raina-Sharon Verma controversy; says people should know how to laugh and make others laugh
articles.summary: Singer Kailash Kher has addressed the controversy surrounding jokes about Bihar and Kashmir on 'India's Got Latent' Season 2. The exchange involved co.
articles.body: Singer Kailash Kher has addressed the controversy surrounding jokes about Bihar and Kashmir on 'India's Got Latent' Season 2. The exchange involved comedian Samay Raina and comedian Sharon Verma. Clips from their interaction have attracted criticism on social media.The discussion has also raised questions about the boundaries of comedy. Kailash Kher has now shared his thoughts on how performers should approach sensitive subjects. However, he did not directly attack either Samay Raina or Sharon Verma.Kailash Kher stresses discipline in creativitySpeaking to ANI, Kailash Kher was asked about comedians using subjects related to Biharis and Kashmiri Pandits for humour. He explained his position by drawing a comparison with music.The singer said creative expression also requires discipline. “Look, if I’ll tell you in terms of music, then music is not just a tune its something that can also make you laugh, its also a form of discipline. So, you should stay in music," he said.Kailash Kher further explained that mistakes in artistic expression could change how the audience interprets it. “If your music tune is not correct, then you may end in making fun of someone," Kailash Kher said.Singer talks about awareness and courtesyKailash Kher then expanded his comments beyond music. He stressed the importance of remaining conscious of one's words and behaviour. “To islie manushye ko chaitanye me rehna chahie, tameez me rehna chahie… or apni apni tameez se sb baat krein, to sbko itna to pta hi hai kaise jeena hai, kese hasna hai or kese hsaana hai, kese kisi ka dil jeetna hai…" (“So, a person should remain conscious and aware, and should maintain basic decency. If everyone speaks with that sense of decency, then everyone knows how to live, how to laugh, how to make others laugh, and how to win someone’s heart.”) he said.“There will be critics, there will be haters, there will be jealous people. Then you will realise that you have come so far," he said.What happened between Samay Raina and Sharon Verma?The controversy followed an exchange between Samay Raina and Sharon Verma during 'India's Got Latent' Season 2. Sharon Verma had previously appeared as a contestant in the show's first season. She returned in the second season as a panellist. The panel also included Orry, Archana Puran Singh and Nishant Suri.During the episode, Samay Raina made a joke about Sharon Verma's Bihari background. The comment referred to stereotypes surrounding people from Bihar moving outside the state for employment. Sharon Verma responded with a joke about Samay Raina's Kashmiri identity. Her remark included a reference to “getting stoned". She also said that she had “at least left her state by choice."The exchange was presented as banter during the episode. Clips later circulated widely on social media. The references to Bihar and Kashmir subsequently became a subject of criticism.Samay Raina and Sharon Verma yet to respondNeither Samay Raina nor Sharon Verma has publicly responded to the criticism surrounding their exchange so far.Meanwhile, Kailash Kher is also set to release his latest romantic single 'Tham Jaa'. The song is scheduled to arrive on major streaming platforms today, September 7, 2026.Give your child the gift of confidence! Claim your exclusive TOI Masterclass spot today!

articles.title: Proud parents Kim Kardashian and Kanye West REUNITE to support daughter North West at sold out Chicago concert - WATCH
articles.summary: Kim Kardashian and Kanye West put their differences aside to support their daughter North West as she took centre stage for her first solo gig in Chic.
articles.body: Kim Kardashian and Kanye West put their differences aside to support their daughter North West as she took centre stage for her first solo gig in Chicago.According to various reports, North, rocking her blue hair and elaborate costume, took to the stage to perform a rap set at a sold-out show on Saturday. While the teen rocked the stage, both her parents, Kim and Kanye, were seen in attendance and cheering her on.While fans shared videos of the two proudly recording their daughter, the estranged couple made sure to keep their distance. Videos show Kim and Kanye watching the performance from opposite balconies. According to a TikTok video from the event, Kanye attended the gig alongside members of his crew on one balcony. Kardashian, on the other hand, watched from a parallel balcony with her set of friends.The proud mom also took to her Instagram Stories to share footage of the packed venue ahead of North’s performance. Another clip showed the crowd jumping and cheering as they waited for the teenager to take the stage.North performed several tracks including N0rth4evr, and reportedly also performed unreleased songs during the set. The teenager has previously collaborated with her father, joining him for performances of 'Talking' and 'Piercing on My Hand' during his comeback concert at SoFi Stadium in early August.North’s solo performance comes amid controversy surrounding the teen's dramatic transformation. From her piercings to her dyed blue hair, and taking over the stage at just 13, has sparked concern among a section of fans calling the performance 'inappropriate'. Others have slammed Kim and Kanye for “bad parenting”.North is the eldest of Kardashian and West’s four children. The former couple also share Saint, 10, Chicago, 8, and Psalm, 7.Following their messy divorce, West has been married to Bianca Censori since 2022. Kardashian, meanwhile, went public with her relationship with Formula One driver Lewis Hamilton in February 2026 after months of dating.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Quote of the day by Jennifer Lawrence: 'I like when things are hard; if something seems difficult or impossible, it interests me,' powerful life lesson on accepting challenges and turning problems into motivation from the 'X-Men' star
articles.summary: Explore Jennifer Lawrence's inspiring quote on embracing challenges and the motivation to overcome difficulties in life. Learn how she turns obstacles into opportunities.
articles.body: They say when the going gets tough, the tough get going. It's a strong life lesson, but something that is easier said than done. However, it appears Marvel star Jennifer Lawrence lives by this philosophy. Thus, once during an interview, she shared that instead of running away from challenging times, she embraces them. She enjoys challenges, likes her competitive side and finds things interesting when they seem impossible. Sharing her philosophy in today's quote of the day, highlighting how difficult times can be turned into opportunities.Today’s quote of the day by Jennifer Lawrence reads: “I like when things are hard; I’m very competitive. If something seems difficult or impossible, it interests me.”What does Jennifer Lawrence’s quote mean?While speaking to W Magazine, Lawrence shared these words. Her quote is quite self-explanatory, shedding light on how the 'X-Men' star deals with difficult times. Jennifer describes herself as competitive and says that when things seem difficult or even impossible, they make her more interested in taking them on. Instead of stepping away from a challenge.How is Jennifer Lawrence’s quote relevant today?Challenges are part of everyday life, whether it is a difficult assignment, a career goal, a new skill or a personal setback. The words are a reminder that hard doesn’t always mean failure. But sometimes it is the motivation to keep going. She gets people to look at difficult situations with interest instead of fear. It’s a mentality that can transform pressure into opportunity for growth.Jennifer Lawrence’s early lifeJennifer Lawrence was born on August 15, 1990, in Indian Hills, Kentucky. She became interested in acting at an early age, acting in school plays and local theatre. When she was 14, she travelled to New York with her mother to follow acting opportunities after being spotted by a talent scout.Later, she moved to Los Angeles and began building her career.Jennifer Lawrence’s rise to fameInterestingly, her quote also reflects on her journey. She started working as a child star and bloomed into one of Hollywood's biggest names, with her breakthrough performance in ‘The Bill Engvall Show.’ This was followed by critical acclaim in 2010 for ‘Winter’s Bone’. Global stardom touched her feet when 'X-Men: First Class' came out. Later, with 'The Hunger Games,' she won hearts again.She had another big milestone with her role in ‘Silver Linings Playbook,’ for which she won the Academy Award for Best Actress. She later appeared in movies including ‘American Hustle,’ ‘Joy,’ ‘Passengers,’ ‘Mother!,’ ‘Red Sparrow,’ ‘Don’t Look Up’ and ‘No Hard Feelings.’Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Sanjay Dutt uses Yerwada prison joke to skip speaking Marathi on stage: 'Main 6 saal jail me raha, tab bhi nahi seekh paya'
articles.summary: Sanjay Dutt found a clever way to sidestep an awkward on-stage moment when Maharashtra Transport Minister Pratap Sarnaik asked him to speak in Marathi.
articles.body: Sanjay Dutt found a clever way to sidestep an awkward on-stage moment when Maharashtra Transport Minister Pratap Sarnaik asked him to speak in Marathi at his Dahi Handi event. Instead of attempting the language, the actor cracked a self-deprecating joke about his time in jail, leaving the audience in splits and setting off a wave of reactions online.Sanjay Dutt says he couldn't learn Marathi in six yearsClips from the Dahi Handi event, now doing rounds on social media, show Sanjay Dutt and Pratap Sarnaik sharing the stage along with other guests. The minister referenced his department's recent order requiring Mumbai's autorickshaw drivers to know basic Marathi, joking, "Aajkal main sab logon ko Marathi sikha raha hoon (These days, I’ve been teaching Marathi to everyone)." He then switched to Marathi and turned the spotlight on Sanjay Dutt, telling the gathering that although the actor speaks in Hindi, everyone present could still follow Marathi.Taking the mic, Sanjay Dutt responded with humour, saying, "Pratap bhai. Main 6 saal jail me raha, Yervada mein. Tab bhi Marathi nahi seekh paaya. Main thoda seekha tha (Pratap bhai, I spent six years in jail at Yerwada. Even then, I couldn’t learn Marathi. I picked up a little bit of it, though)." He then wrapped an arm around the minister, referring to him as an old friend, and added, "Main Pratap bhai ka aabhaari hoon ki mujhe yahan bulaye. Hamara rishta bahut purana hai, 25 saal ho gaye hain (I’m grateful to Pratap bhai for inviting me here. We share a very old relationship; it’s been 25 years)."Sanjay Dutt's projectsOn the work front, Sanjay Dutt last appeared in a cameo in the Arabic film '7 Dogs', starring alongside Salman Khan. The project failed to make a mark either critically or at the box office. He will also star in the sequel to his film 'Khalnayak'. On the other hand, the actor has been pushing filmmaker Rajkumar Hirani for the third instalment of 'Munna Bhai 3'.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: 'You can see everything': Nathan Fielder unveils Elizabeth Holmes documentary teaser; social media reacts, 'unstoppable force meets immovable object'
articles.summary: Nathan Fielder has brought his secret documentary about Elizabeth Holmes into the spotlight. Titled 'You Can See Everything', the documentary received.
articles.body: Nathan Fielder has brought his secret documentary about Elizabeth Holmes into the spotlight. Titled 'You Can See Everything', the documentary received a surprise screening at the Telluride Film Festival on September 6. A24 has now released its first teaser.The documentary follows Elizabeth Holmes, the former Theranos founder who became one of Silicon Valley's most controversial figures. Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim directed the film together. According to Firstpost, the project began as an intimate attempt to document Holmes before her imprisonment. It eventually developed into a three-year filmmaking journey.'You Can See Everything' gets surprise Telluride screeningThe documentary was unveiled unexpectedly at the Telluride Film Festival. Its screening came ahead of the planned theatrical release in October. The film's story begins 34 days before Elizabeth Holmes was due to enter prison. During that period, she invited a film crew to record her life and experiences.What began as a relatively straightforward documentary project took an unexpected turn. The filmmakers continued following the story for three years. The extended filming period forms a major part of the documentary's premise.Elizabeth Holmes became internationally known after Theranos faced intense scrutiny over its blood-testing technology and business practices. Her legal troubles eventually led to a prison sentence.Nathan Fielder and Elizabeth Holmes face off in teaserA24's teaser introduces viewers to the unusual dynamic between Nathan Fielder and Elizabeth Holmes. One of the most striking moments features the two looking directly at each other.The exchange appears to test the level of trust between them. Elizabeth Holmes addresses the possibility of deception while speaking to Nathan Fielder.“I don’t have anything to deceive you on,” Holmes tells him. “Of course I’m not deceiving you. I’m engaging with you as a human being. Why would I deceive you? There’s no reason for me to do that.” Nathan Fielder responds, “OK. Alright. OK, good chat,” before asking, “You’re being real right now?” Elizabeth Holmes then replies, “I’m always being real.”Viewers react to the documentary teaserThe first footage has generated strong reactions online. Many viewers have focused on the prolonged eye contact between Nathan Fielder and Elizabeth Holmes. One person described their interaction as an “unstoppable force meets immovable object.”Another viewer wrote, “My man was trying to find her soul in her eyes and found nothing.” A third reaction focused on Nathan Fielder's decision not to look away, writing, “You cant be the first to break eye contact with Elizabeth Holmes, glad Nathan knew this.”Another viewer compared the anticipation surrounding the documentary to a major superhero movie, writing, “This is my Avengers: Doomsday.”Who directed 'You Can See Everything'?Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim serve as the directors of 'You Can See Everything'. Nathan Fielder is known for projects that combine comedy, reality and unconventional storytelling. His credits include 'Nathan For You' and 'The Rehearsal'. Lance Oppenheim has directed documentaries such as 'Some Kind of Heaven' and 'Primetime'.The filmmakers have taken an unusual approach to Elizabeth Holmes' story. Instead of focusing only on her rise and downfall, the documentary follows her through a much longer period.'You Can See Everything' set for October releaseA24's official description outlines the unusual premise behind the documentary. “Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes You Can See Everything.”'You Can See Everything' is scheduled to arrive in theatres in October.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: 'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection Day 32 [LIVE]: Rs 2 crore budget film on Neem Karoli Baba eyeing to cross Rs 130 crore in India
articles.summary: 'Hanuman Ansh' is currently enjoying a successful box office run while showing no signs of slowing despite box office competitions. After a dead start.
articles.body: 'Hanuman Ansh' is currently enjoying a successful box office run while showing no signs of slowing despite box office competitions. After a dead start, the film on Neem Karoli Baba has been earning praise from all quarters. The Vishal Chaturvedi-directed movie is currently in its fifth week at the cinemas. Here's how it is performing at the box office on the fifth Monday.'Hanuman Ansh' box office collection Day 32 [LIVE]Led by actor Shobhinaww Satyaa, the film debuted at the box office with very poor box office earnings. The first week raked in Rs 1.08 crore, while the second week added another Rs 40 lakhs to its tally. The film picked up the momentum in the third week.Now, according to the Sacnilk report, on Day 32, the film is currently running across 4891 shows. It has collected a net of Rs 3.39 crore as of now today. The numbers are expected to rise as the day progresses.With that, the total India gross collections are now Rs 148.40 crore, while the total India net collections have reached Rs 125.52 crore. The final India collections for today are yet to be reported.If the trend continues, the movie is expected to cross Rs 130 crore in India.Day/week-wise collections (India net)Week 1: 1.08 croreWeek 2: Rs 0.40 croreWeek 3: Rs 10.40 croreWeek 4: Rs 61 croreDay 29: Rs 10 croreDay 30: Rs 16.50 croreDay 31: Rs 22.75 croreDay 32: Rs 3.39 crore [LIVE]Total: Rs 125.52 croreMore about 'Hanuman Ansh'Written and directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, 'Hanuman Ansh' is based on the life, philosophy and spiritual teachings of Neem Karoli Baba, revered by devotees as Maharaj Ji.Reportedly produced on a modest budget of around Rs 1.75–2 crore, the film arrived in cinemas on August 7, 2026. It initially faced competition from 'Ohh My Dog' and 'Aryabhatta Ka Zero', before taking on 'Awarapan 2' and 'Batwara 1947'. Despite its limited budget, 'Hanuman Ansh' continues its theatrical run and is now competing against Yash-starrer 'Toxic' as well as the recently released 'Mirzapur: The Movie'.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources. articles.title: Yash starrer 'Toxic- A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups' OTT deal value crashes to Rs 30 crore following its box office debacle - Report
articles.summary: 'Toxic- A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups', directed by Geetu Mohandas and led by an ensemble cast including Yash, Nayanthara, Kiara Advani, Tara Sutaria, Hu.
articles.body: 'Toxic- A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups', directed by Geetu Mohandas and led by an ensemble cast including Yash, Nayanthara, Kiara Advani, Tara Sutaria, Huma Qureshi, and Rukmini Vasanth, was widely tipped to be among the year's biggest hits. That prediction fell short, however, as the film's promising start gave way to a sharp decline at the box office, leaving it labelled a flop. The setback could also affect its digital release plans, given reports that no OTT deal had been sealed before the theatrical launch.Toxic's OTT offer drops from Rs 200 crore to Rs 30 croreAccording to Bollywood Hungama, an OTT platform had reportedly offered the ‘Toxic’ team Rs 150 crore for the film's post-theatrical streaming rights before its release. However, the makers held out for Rs 200 crore, with Yash reportedly confident that a strong box office run would help the film command that higher figure once released. The digital players are now offering an amount as low as Rs. 30 crore for the post-theatrical streaming rights for all languages. The biggest offer has come from Zee 5. Reportedly, the makers are also considering a fresh edit for the digital release in hopes of pushing the OTT offer higher.Toxic's OTT deal remains unconfirmedHowever, no official word has been shared yet regarding Toxic's OTT deal.Toxic's box office collection so far‘Toxic’ opened to Rs 101.10 crore net (all languages) in India, but its box office run soon began to taper off. By day 12, the film had earned Rs 2.42 crore net (all languages), pushing its domestic net total to Rs 245.75 crore. The film's worldwide gross, meanwhile, stands at Rs 337.80 crore.Give your child the gift of confidence! Claim your exclusive TOI Masterclass spot today!
